items.title: Keep sessions to one task each
items.detail: Each reply read 203k tokens on average in the last 7 days (143k the week before). Re-reading it was 46% of Claude spend. Start a new session, or /clear, for each new task.

items.title: Start fresh after a break instead of resuming
items.detail: 16 cache rebuilds cost $18 in the last 7 days (19 the week before). The cache expires after an idle hour, so after a break start a new session, or /compact before you step away.

items.title: Ask for tests on the tricky part up front
items.detail: 32 later commits changed files from 20 tasks shipped in the last 28 days, most after PR #200 (4). Ask Claude to test the risky part before it builds.
